EXPLANATION: The intense band at 2255 cm⁻¹ is characteristic of a nitrile ν(C≡N) stretch (typical ~2210–2260 cm⁻¹), and among the candidates only 1 contains a C≡N group. The strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2940 and 2888 cm⁻¹ and CH bending near 1457/1430 cm⁻¹ support an aliphatic framework (GFQ-003). The presence of a triple-bond band at high frequency is consistent with the bond order-frequency relation (FRQ-001). Candidate 1 also plausibly accounts for other mid-IR/Raman skeletal bands observed, whereas non-nitrile candidates lack a clear assignment for the prominent 2255 cm⁻¹ peak.
